name: Hanasaki Sakura
source:
Touma's younger sister who likes to be spoiled by Touma. But after several years she was trying to put distance between the two and gives him a cold attitude. A cool and intelligent girl who actually wanted to be spoiled.

When she is forced to watch her brother choose a bride-to-be, her true intention finally comes out. But even though she becomes bold in showing her love, she also shows a bit of tsundere reactions. 

"I can become onii-chan's bride, can I?"
